sloka: तेषां तद्व्याहृतं श्रुत्वा रामस्य च मनोगतम् ।विज्ञाय सुमहातेजा मुनिर्वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ।। ७.९५.९ ॥
transliteration: teṣāṁ tadvyāhṛtaṁ śrutvā rāmasya ca manogatam ।vijñāya sumahātejā munirvākyamathābravīt ।। 7.95.9 ॥

translations.english: Having bowed down to the great soul, who was shining with immeasurable splendor, they spoke Rama's words, which were both soft and sweet.
